summary: A reusable cross-layer head-major BF16 K/V scratch removes AOTriton's long-context token-major head stride. Copy-inclusive full prefill is neutral at 512, positive at 4K, and improves 32K/64K by 3.383%/7.001% with byte-exact full-model state. gfx1151 promotes the path through its backend capability through the validated 64K allocation class; gfx1100, explicit env=0, oversized contexts, and allocation denial retain strided AOTriton.

platform.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

source.candidate_state: candidate parent plus the paged-KV head-major kernel, registry/runtime integration, bounded scratch owner, tests, screen, and evidence in this logical unit
source.lineage: net-new in-tree copy informed by Nathanw1014/llama.cpp ab5910a; no external source body copied

implementation.physical_layout: persistent KV remains token-major paged; temporary output is [kv_head, scratch_capacity, head_dim] BF16
implementation.owner: one tracked K/V pair per resident session, reused across all full-attention layers
implementation.validated_default_scope: hip_gfx1151 sessions with rounded capacity <=65792 tokens
fallbacks: generic complete-KVLiveSpans page gather when dense identity is not proven
existing strided AOTriton when disabled, over token/byte cap, registry-missing, or allocation-denied
existing native paged attention below the AOTriton threshold

protocol.session: One independent right-sized resident process per end-to-end workload
protocol.prefill: forced bulk prefill, bulk attention mode, WMMA prefill, GEMV decode, no queue drain
protocol.decode: fresh state-bound graph replay for measured runs; eager discarded warmup
protocol.build: hermetic TheRock HIP, precomputed compiler-version file, require-cached-build
protocol.control_command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_GGUF_DECODE_REPACK=1 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 python3 scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine gguf --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --backend hip_gfx1151 --workloads <shape>/128 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --warmup-decode-tokens 1 --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --use-wmma-prefill --use-gemv-decode --graph-replay-decode --prefill-queue-drain none --compiler-version-file <precomputed> --require-cached-build --json <output>

attention_subwindow.correctness: strided and head-major AOTriton outputs have zero BF16-bit mismatches at every shape

correctness.primitive: lengths 1/255/256/257, two KV heads, permuted pages, untouched sentinels, and dense/generic equality are byte-exact
correctness.full_model_512: candidate matches control token, selected-logit bits, all logits, all 40 post-layer hidden rows, all 30 Conv/GDN states, and all ten K/V prefixes
correctness.forced_capacity_denial: one-byte cap allocates no head-major scratch and matches the same full state
correctness.measured_rows: all candidate runs have finite stable logits and final token 9707

decision.reason: The copy-inclusive path is neutral at 512, positive at 4K, materially positive at 32K/64K, byte-exact at primitive and full-model boundaries, and has bounded tracked allocation plus exact fallback.
decision.unfused_fallback: Existing strided AOTriton remains selected on explicit disable, cap/allocation/registry failure, unsupported backend, or oversized resident capacity.

limitations: The default is limited to gfx1151 and the validated rounded capacity class of at most 65792 tokens; larger sessions retain strided AOTriton.
The production dense-prefix copy is qualified before eviction; the generic sibling covers non-identity page tables but does not broaden AOTriton to sparse post-eviction contexts.
The performance workload uses repeated token ID 9707; correctness additionally compares complete hidden, recurrent, KV, and logit state rather than only the emitted token.
